singleSourced.context: As a long fan of the series I find absurd that people say that it "doesn't feel like Castlevania" when the series has had different approaches before and honestly this isn't even one of the most radical.
If you're plan on picking the game up on Xbox, it'll cost you £24.98 / $29.99 and it's launching October 15th onto Xbox Series X|S and Xbox PC with Play Anywhere support.
